description: Contains an abstract class HTMLPurifier_Definition that provides base functionality for definition datatype objects in the HTMLPurifier library, including setup routines and serialization aspects.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Definition
classes.description: An abstract superclass for definition datatype objects in the HTMLPurifier library, handling setup state and defining an abstract method for specific setup implementations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the definition object if it hasn't been set up already, marking it as setup and invoking the doSetup method.
